title: Metamorphic Relations as a Robustness Test for Trusted Monitors

original_idea.body:
# Metamorphic Relations as a Robustness Test for Trusted Monitors

**Problem:** A trusted monitor should give consistent verdicts under semantically irrelevant changes. If its score swings on such transformations, it is brittle.

**Direction:** Borrow metamorphic testing. Define MRs that should preserve a monitor's verdict and MRs that should flip it. Apply to SHADE-Arena transcripts, query a cheap monitor, and measure MR violation rate. Produce a monitor brittleness score.

**Why it matters:** Surfaces invariance failures before deployment, a cheap diagnostic needing no model lab and no oracle.

**Relevant context:** Metamorphic testing SLR (arXiv:2507.22610); Redwood trusted monitoring (AI Control 2023).
